questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Caring for Pets?
choices: Every pet needs informed gentle care.
Only dogs need play exercise and rest.

questions.rationale: Dogs need play exercise and rest. Rabbits need space hay shelter and company. Every pet needs informed gentle care. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Every pet needs informed gentle care.
